index.title: Coaching Desk: fees, attendance and parent updates for tuition centres
index.description: Coaching Desk is a mobile app for tuition centres, coaching academies and home tutors in India: students, attendance, fees, WhatsApp reminders, receipts and results, in English and Hindi.

hero.eyebrow: For tuition centres, coaching academies and home tutors
hero.title: Your coaching centre, managed from your phone.
hero.lead: Students, attendance, fees and results in one simple app, and every parent kept informed on WhatsApp, in English or Hindi.

audience.title: Built for how you teach
audience.a1Text: Many batches a day, a front desk, fees every month.
audience.a2Text: Teachers and staff with their own access, tests and results.
audience.a3Text: A few students, no paperwork, reminders that go out by themselves.

how.title: Up and running in five minutes
how.lead: No training, no computer. If you can use WhatsApp, you can use Coaching Desk.
how.s1Text: Type them in, or paste a whole list at once. Roll numbers, parent and student phone numbers.
how.s2Text: Tap only the absentees. Record cash or UPI in one tap, and the receipt goes out.
how.s3Text: Fee reminders, absence alerts, receipts and results reach parents on WhatsApp, by themselves.

features.title: Everything a centre needs, nothing it doesn't
features.f1Text: Everyone starts present: tap only the students who are absent and save.
features.f1b1: Works without internet; it sends itself when you're back online
features.f1b3: Parents get an absence alert, once per class
features.f2: Know who has paid and who hasn't
features.f2Text: Monthly, quarterly or one-time fees are billed automatically. You always know what's collected and what's pending.
features.f2b1: Record cash, UPI or bank payments in one tap
features.f2b2: A receipt reaches the parent on WhatsApp
features.f2b3: Pending, overdue and the most overdue families at a glance
features.f3Text: Polite, clear WhatsApp messages in the parent's language, without you typing a word.
features.f3b1: Fee reminders a few days before and after the due date
features.f3b2: Notices for holidays and timing changes
features.f3b3: Only to parents who agreed, and never at night
features.f4Text: Enter marks quickly and send every parent their child's result.
features.f4b1: Marks in roll-number order, half marks allowed
features.f4b3: One result card per student, on WhatsApp

safety.title: Safe for parents, by design
safety.lead: Coaching Desk never sends payment links. Our messages only tell parents what is due, and they pay you directly, in cash or to your UPI ID. So if a parent ever receives a link asking for fees, they know it is fake.
safety.b2: Messages only to parents who agreed
safety.b4: Export or delete your data any time

pricing.title: Simple, honest pricing
pricing.lead: Start free. Upgrade when WhatsApp automation starts saving you time.
pricing.note: Every new institute gets a {days}-day free trial of Pro. GST as applicable.

faq.title: Questions owners ask
faq.q1: Do parents need to install anything?
faq.a1: No. Parents only receive WhatsApp messages. Only you, your teachers and your staff use the app.
faq.a2: Yes. Attendance can be taken without internet and is sent automatically when the phone is back online. Screens show the last saved data.
faq.a3: Directly to you, the way they do today: cash at the centre or UPI to your own UPI ID. You record it in one tap and the parent gets a receipt. We take no commission.
faq.q4: Can I use it in Hindi?
faq.a4: Yes. The app works fully in Hindi and English, and parents' messages can go in either language.
faq.a5: Your data is stored in India and only your institute's team can see it. You can download all of it, or delete it, at any time.
faq.a6: Yes. Paid plans are monthly or yearly with no lock-in. If you stop paying, you move to the Free plan and keep your data.
